The universal gate set by name - the symbolic register:
gate applications can reference gates by name and the
tool layer resolves names to matrices.
Record: QC modelling decisions 2026-11-09.md #57.

The famous qubit states by name - the symbolic register
for states. zero = |0>, one = |1>,
plus = (|0> + |1>)/sqrt(2), minus = (|0> - |1>)/sqrt(2).
Record: QC modelling decisions 2026-11-09.md #57.

in: angle theta in radians; out: the pair
(cos theta, sin theta) = e^{i theta}.
The phase factory: T = pi/4, S = pi/2, Z = pi.

in: four pairs a11, a12, a21, a22 (Real[2] each);
out: Real[8], pair per entry, row-major.

in: Real x >= 0; out: sqrt(x) via ** 0.5
(RealFunctions::sqrt has no evaluated body).
